## Problem and change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any related issues.

## Validation

List checks run and their results. For UI changes, include screenshots. Explain any checks you could not run.

## Compatibility and dependencies

Describe breaking changes and migration steps, if any. Identify added dependencies or copied assets and their source, license, and required notices.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and signed off my contribution commits under the DCO.
- [ ] I added or updated documentation and relevant tests, or explained why they are unnecessary.
- [ ] I removed credentials and sensitive data from the change and diagnostics.

Report vulnerabilities privately using [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
